sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of polidocanol during breastfeeding. Although polidocanol is unlikely to adversely affect the breastfed infant, international guidelines recommend that breastfeeding be withheld for 2 days after sclerotherapy.
